angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 854,320 km at 97.14 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.2945 +/- 0.0206 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 97.14 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.228 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract): 854,320 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.023 +/- 0.041 solar masses from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5844 +/- 42 K from Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Chaturvedi et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3493 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-3493.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.270, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): spectral type G1/2 V, from Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 119355: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.19294, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): age 7.3 Gyr, from Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): rotation period 37.4 d, from Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3493 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Chaturvedi et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...697A.169C/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
